desc:
Fight through the story, gear up, and duel other players.

EARLY BETA
Game balancing is subject to change. Found a bug or have an idea? Send feedback with the Feedback button via update log.

PC Controls
A / D - Move
W / Space - Jump
S - Duck
Hold back - Block
Double tap forward - Dash
Double tap back - Flip back
Left Click / P - Punch
Right Click / L - Kick
Q - Throw
E - Magic

Edit controls in settings!

Play on mobile, PC and Console
Like and favorite for more updates!
